rationale: Approved in the SyncAI project thread on 2026-10-01. Migration 20270101850000_kb_document_security.sql adds fail-closed retrieval filtering so only cleared or independently released chunks can be returned, and wraps admitted content as JSON-escaped untrusted evidence data. The latest retrieve_kb_context definition preserves session-resolved tenant isolation, shared-corpus visibility, permitted_claims, trust rank, redistributability, approved/non-superseded governed-source gating, ranking and limits. kb_document_classes and kb_claim_types are referenced but not redefined; their digests move because the governed-object fingerprint covers migration references. Runtime step 87 proved quarantine, split-boundary detection, all-retriever exclusion, direct-release denial, AAL2/verified-factor separation of duties, tenant walls, rescan and rejection. Release grants retrieval standing only, not engineering or operational authority.
